verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 exposes programmable interfaces: Redfish/IPMI management (docs-10) and the CUDA runtime and driver APIs (docs-29). That makes API versioning and deprecation a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404. The NeMo 1.0→2.0 and GenAI-Perf migration guides cover separate software products, not a B200 versioned-API or deprecation policy, so they earn no credit here.
